_about: Help-centre articles the Helpdesk answers from. Written by the IT team: trusted.

articles.title: Reset your VPN token
articles.text: Open the AnyCompany VPN client, choose Settings, then Reset token, and sign in again with your staff account. The new token works straight away.

articles.title: Change your password
articles.text: Go to the staff portal, choose Security, then Change password. Use at least 14 characters.

articles.title: Reset your MFA
articles.text: The Helpdesk can reset MFA for your own account only. You will be asked to enrol your authenticator again at your next sign-in.

articles.title: Connect to office Wi-Fi
articles.text: Choose the AnyCompany-Staff network and sign in with your staff account. Guests use AnyCompany-Guest.
